verdict.rationale: n8n documents Git-based version control as a product feature (pricing page) and has an administration docs section on using source control and environments with push and pull of changes, which covers the story's core of versioning workflows across environments. The evidence is only page titles and feature-list entries, so the dev-to-production promotion flow is implied by the source-control-and-environments doc path rather than described. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the dev-to-prod promotion process, clarity on which plan tier includes Git version control, independent or hands-on corroboration.
